function: S81 return capture: the unchanged ot_dsrom_rd64_vm_capture (ENABLE, ROOTS 128, CAPACITY 1, VM_AW 19, VM_ALWAYS_ACCEPT 1) with the canonical S81 profile quota, exactly as the spine instantiates it; per-root 2-row pair packer (4-row hold) and ot_ratio_cdc_fifo (DEPTH 4, 103 b) to the serial VM; status lane (DEPTH 2)
vm_side_contract: the VM accepts every t_vm lane word every serial cycle: up to 2 scalar row writes per root per serial cycle (256 scalar write ports, or 128 two-row ports); the core modelled 128 scalar ports at the core clock (1 row per root per stream cycle = 1.33 per serial cycle)
faults: as rd64 (over-quota, error row, pos > np, address range, reset request, accept without valid) + protocol fault (phase word while not ready) + hold overflow (never seen: back-to-back 56-row bursts per root PASS) + gather fault
bf16: recomputed from fp32 exactly as ot_v41_ret_root: ({1b0, fp32} + 0x7FFF + fp32[16])[31:16]

generator_changes.what: dsfd_sp_gather / dsfd_sp_capture become REAL views (their LEF pins), placed abutting: gather (S) -> capture -> VM (N); the gather->capture and capture->VM buses are abutment nets, not hub-bus stations
generator_changes.why: 6,947-b and 13,376-b buses; the rows of a phase leave every root at once (I66 trace: 576 rows in 6 edges, 128 writers/edge), so the return path must carry one row per root per stream cycle
